lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple high-luminance, roughly circular blobs are visible on the lateral flank posterior to the pectoral fin, arranged in a semi-regular staggered grid with approximately 5-10 blob-widths of separation between centroids.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the visible mid-section.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: At least three prominent horizontal ridges are visible running along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp transition from high-luminance pixels on the dorsal edge to deep shadow on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin displays a high-density distribution of small, high-intensity spots that are significantly smaller in diameter than the blobs on the lateral flank.
